summary: These Regulations amend the provisions concerning the administration of Air Departure Tax (“ADT”) in Part 4 (Payment, collection and management of tax) of the Air Departure Tax (Scotland) Act 2017 (“the 2017 Act”). title: The Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the fourth set of commencement regulations bringing into force provisions of the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026 (c. 21) (“the Act”). They are the first set of regulations commencing provisions of the Act which substantively relate to a territory other than England, namely section 10 which relates to social care in England and Wales.

Administrative and Financial Provisions Act (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: An Act to make further provision with respect to the administration and financing of public services in Northern Ireland, in particular, measures to provide powers to undertake certain activities, to enable charging for certain activities and to modify arrangements for financial governance.

summary: An Act to make provision about finance.

title: Correction slip
summary: These Regulations, made under sections 51(3), 52(1) and 52(3) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006, specify fees relating to immigration and nationality. They follow on from the Immigration and Nationality (Fees) Order 2011, which sets out the applications, services and processes related to immigration and nationality in respect of which fees may be specified in regulations.

title: The Strategic Planning Authorities (Spatial Development Strategy) Regulations 2026
summary: Part 1A of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (c. 5) (inserted by section 58 of the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34)) requires strategic planning authorities to prepare a spatial development strategy (“SDS”) for their area. These Regulations make provision as to the procedure to be followed in connection with the preparation of a SDS.

title: The Strategic Planning (Consequential and Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations revoke and amend secondary legislation relating to strategic planning.

title: The Strategic Planning (Costs of Public Examinations) (Standard Daily Amount) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations, which apply in relation to England only, apply where the Secretary of State is authorised to recover costs arising in connection with a public examination under section 12I or 12P(6)(a) of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (c. 5).

title: The Spatial Development Strategy (Examination Procedure) Rules 2026
summary: Part 1A of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (c. 5) (inserted by section 58 of the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34)) requires strategic planning authorities to prepare a spatial development strategy. Unless the Secretary of State directs otherwise, a draft spatial development strategy must be subject to an examination.

title: The Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 10) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force sections 61 to 65 of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (c. 18) (“the 2025 Act”). Regulation 2(1) brings the provisions specified in that regulation into force on 9th November 2026. Regulation 2(2) brings section 61(3) of the 2025 Act into force at 12.01 am on that date. These are the 10th commencement regulations made under the 2025 Act.

title: The Building Safety Levy (Scotland) Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force sections 6, 7, 9, 10(3) and (4), 11, 12(2) to (4), 15(6) and (7), 18, 19, 22, 23, 24(2), 30(1), 31 and 32 of the Building Safety Levy (Scotland) Act 2026 (“the Act”) on 1 December 2026. This brings into force all the powers to make regulations under the Act.

title: The Provision of Early Learning and Childcare (Specified Children) (Scotland) Amendment Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Provision of Early Learning and Childcare (Specified Children) (Scotland) Order 2014 (“the 2014 Order”). The 2014 Order specifies those children who are eligible pre-school children for the purposes of section 47(2)(c)(ii) of the Children and Young People (Scotland) Act 2014 and who are therefore entitled to the mandatory amount of early learning and childcare (as defined in section 48 of that Act).

title: The Trusts and Succession (Scotland) Act 2024 (Commencement No. 2 and Saving and Transitory Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring certain provisions of the Trusts and Succession (Scotland) Act 2024 (“the Act”) into force on 14 December 2026.

title: Act of Adjournal (Criminal Procedure Rules 1996 Amendment) (Miscellaneous) (No. 2) 2026
summary: This Act of Adjournal inserts a new Chapter 74 into the Criminal Procedure Rules 1996 (“the 1996 Rules”) to make provision for the application, variation, extension and discharge of IP address and domain name suspension orders under the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (“the 2026 Act”).

title: The Cumberland (Electoral Changes) Order 2026
summary: This Order makes changes to electoral arrangements for the district of Cumberland following recommendations made by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England. This Order does not change the boundary of the district itself.
